# NCR HTML Root Admission V2 - Held Design Contract

Memory class: governed-baseline
docType: baseline
Status: HOLD_ADMISSION_RECONCILIATION
Date: 2026-10-15
Batch ID: CVF-NCR-HTML-ROOT-ADMISSION-V2-DESIGN
sourceHead: 022edc35a100dd1b989f182c67d3974c4389a75a
Decision owner: Local technical design; operator owns changed effect authority
Current execution grant: NONE

## Purpose

Complete the consolidated admission design and prospective packet requested by
the current source-only PLAN. The finite proposed outcome remains fresh HTML
v1/v2, request-row authenticity and real native cleanup. This contract groups
all six source findings instead of releasing a timeout-only repair.

## Source / Predecessor Evidence

`docs/assessments/CVF_NCR_HTML_ROOT_BUILD_SOURCE_REASSESSMENT_2026-10-15.md`
and its18-pin evidence define NCR-SR-01..06. The original root contract,
worker/Local failures and current consumed release remain provenance.
`docs/reviews/evidence/ncr-html-root-admission-v2-packet-20261015.json` is the
reviewable prospective packet snapshot, including exact candidate baseline,
work-order and companion bytes. It is not an installed work order.
`docs/reviews/evidence/ncr-html-root-admission-v2-local-20261015.json` binds
the actual declared-state evaluation and the separate redispatch rejection.

## Authority / Scope

Current authority is documentary design, source reads, offline canonical
evaluation and local commits only. No implementation, worker invocation,
native prerequisite query, test substitute, container, browser, provider or
actual profile/store access is released. Source assessment and operator next
instructions permit finishing this design; they do not refill consumed caps.

Same root problem key, ordinal2, predecessor, counters2,0,2,0, two blockers and
feature freeze remain. SCEC chainOrdinal2 is distinct from a prospective
rework round3; neither number may be lowered to pass admission. All six new
findings are dependent obligations, not newly independent critical evidence.

## Integrated Build Scope

PROPOSED_DESIGN_CHOICE: modify the existing six helper/test files only:
`scripts/cvf_ncr_html_owned_profile/__init__.py`,
`scripts/cvf_ncr_html_owned_profile/lifecycle.py`,
`scripts/cvf_ncr_html_owned_profile/profile.py`,
`scripts/cvf_ncr_html_owned_profile/test_control.py`,
`scripts/cvf_ncr_html_owned_profile/journey.cjs`, and
`scripts/cvf_ncr_html_owned_profile/journey.test.cjs`.
The two existing entrypoints are read-only compatibility inputs. The existing
owned-profile CLI already reaches these helpers; no entrypoint edit is needed.
This narrows the eight-code-path family from the source assessment; it does
not add a ninth code path or touch the749-line runner near its750-line limit.
The active proactive-owner registry contains no registered owner domain for
this family. Each helper/test must remain below350 lines. If this topology is
insufficient, stop before an effect and return to Local; no minification or
silent extension. New worker return/proof paths are fixed in the snapshot.

## Design / Six Coupled Obligations

| ID | Required implementation and proof, all prospective |
|---|---|
| AD2-01 | Python validates exact seven fields, types, NFC, synthetic source and distinct anchors, phase cap and control-source hashes before creating a namespace or child. Wrong source/input/receipt stops. |
| AD2-02 | Record each command start, identity, remaining deadline and bounded diagnostics before launch. Retain secret-safe TimeoutExpired output and distinguish timeout/exit/parse/unknown. No fallback or retry of the module-path query. |
| AD2-03 | Reserve GET budget4 engine +6 Web +2 route warm-up; decrement before each request. Global monotonic deadlines clamp commands/HTTP/IPC. Not every timeout schedule can succeed; exhaustion is a truthful stop. |
| AD2-04 | Pin legacy inverse comparisons to0850546 immutable entry blobs, not HEAD. New pure tests challenge the actual event.decision.final_decision/request/timestamp schema and UTF-16 excerpt boundary; preserve the old executed wrong oracle. |
| AD2-05 | One explicitly admitted real inert child proves suspended-create/job/identity/persist/resume/stop/absence before container or product start. Product and utility child processes share bounded ownership; no broad name/PID-only kill. |
| AD2-06 | One failure-preserving terminal boundary collects proxy/reader/native/container/listener/handle-close/persistence errors. Stop acceptance and preserve disposable data on uncertainty; attempt final custody after earlier teardown errors. |

The current Native class owns job/creation handles but does not implement the
new command lifecycle, active-process limit or kill-on-last-job-close policy.
These additions are DOC_ONLY_NEW implementation requirements. Proposed limit:
32 simultaneous job processes, no breakaway; configuration/query failure stops
before a utility query or real child. Last-handle-close termination requires
the corresponding job policy; merely calling CloseHandle is insufficient.
API feasibility reference, not CVF authority or host proof:
[Microsoft Job Objects](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/procthread/job-objects)
and [basic job limits](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/winnt/ns-winnt-jobobject_basic_limit_information).
No SID/DACL/security descriptor, locking or durable storage transaction is
selected. Actual ctypes ABI, host nesting and native behavior require future
phase C proof; documentation is not a successful native observation.

## Phase Budgets / Before-Effect Accounting

All numbers below are proposed new ceilings. Current consumed release counters
remain spent. No unused HTTP allowance moves between actors, phases or grants.

| Phase / per actor | Ceilings and order | Failure / stop |
|---|---|---|
| Preparation / pure tests | one future worker120min; distinct Local60min; includes reads, edits, return/gates. Pure test runner starts at most4 worker/2 Local. Actual negative subprocess substitutes at most27 worker/18 Local, charged separately from runners. | Repeat only selected tests within these aggregate caps; no full legacy runtime replay. Failed controls stop B/C/D. |
| A: source/input | up to8 read-only Git subprocesses, each30s; pin pair/helpers/input/control oracle and production-source bytes. Namespace creation only after pure input validation. | Unknown or mismatched source/grant/input stops; retain documentary evidence. No environment values or active stores. |
| B: installed prerequisites | one context-show, context-inspect, server check and cached-image inspect, each10s; one installed-browser-path module query30s; shared deadline75s. Set/query owned job safety first. | Five utility children maximum; no install/pull/build, second module query or diagnostic retry. Timeout remains UNKNOWN. |
| C: actual native control | one real inert child, at most30s; exact taskkill and tasklist once each; no container or Web/browser. Persist before resume; prove live owned identity before stop and successful absence after stop. | Failed/ambiguous control consumes its slot and stops D; final cleanup still required. No substituted positive or second child. |
| D: product positive | one namespace/profile; one cached engine container; one attached engine CLI, one Web root and one browser helper root. Worker2 exports/evaluates; Local1/1. Readiness12 GETs reserved4/6/2. | Charge starts before effects; no second namespace, container create, engine start, browser profile, fallback export or evaluate retry. |
| E: cleanup | reserve120s after work deadline, clamping each wait; preserve exact identities/custody. Up to32 exact owned process-stop commands plus inspect/remove/container-ps/tasklist/netstat5. | At most37 utility commands; if budget/time/identity/query/close fails, UNKNOWN and preserve stage. No assertion cleanup always succeeds. |

One actor invocation has a900s work deadline including B75, C30 and at most795s
remaining for A/staging/D; A time also consumes that total. Cleanup adds at
most120s of controlled waits; total planned wall envelope1020s. File/OS failure
can prevent timely completion; it must never become a success claim.
Runtime utility command ceilings: B5 + C2 + D10 + E37 =54, with hard cap54;
D10 is junction/create/inspect3, health4, isolation1, forward2 (Local uses1).
There is no spare utility retry. The inert child1 plus product roots3 are4
separate launches; utility children54 are not hidden in that count. Git8 and
test runners/substitutes have their own ledgers above. Browser descendants
remain inside the job's simultaneous32 limit, not32 fresh retry allowances.
Provider/export-replacement/actual-data starts0. Egress and engine network=none
must be proved again for changed code. Full delivery estimate is planning,
not measured billing: dispatch30-45min + worker120min + Local60min, including
gate overhead within each actor's ceiling. Exceeding it stops; no new approval
is needed for ordinary in-envelope repairs after a lawful release.

## Decision / Admission Disposition

HOLD_ADMISSION_RECONCILIATION. Publish the baseline and exact candidate snapshot
for review, not a live round-three work order. The stock scaffold rejects round3
before producing a packet. The stock Review Cost checker also rejects round3
and the lack of new independent critical evidence, without a HOLD exemption.
Neither changing the title nor using SCEC ordinal2 permits calling the next
rework round2. No checker, counter, status or problem-key bypass is selected.

The action-scoped preapproval evaluator checks a narrower source/grammar join.
Its result on the exact isolated snapshot must be consumed alongside the
redispatch checker result, never substituted for overall execution admission.
No approval request for B/C/D is appropriate while the controlling route is
uncloseable. Operator consent alone cannot change the checker's current code.

Next Local action: reconcile the existing round-three escalation owner and
machine admission route as a documentary owner decision, with the smallest
existing-owner remedy or an explicit keep-stopped disposition. The standard
permits operator-cleared same-scope continuation; the checker/scaffold have
no corresponding encoded clearance branch. This is a named route gap, not a
request for the operator to choose an implementation mechanism. A separate
authorized existing-owner correction would be required before code changes;
no new generic checker or silent waiver is proposed here.

## Required Evidence / Acceptance

Design outputs: this source-bound contract; exact prospective pair/companion
snapshot; canonical one-object receipt; separate Review Cost result; conditional
role-graph result; budget arithmetic; unchanged source/history pins; current
roadmap and generated continuity. No implementation acceptance is claimed.
Future execution requires all eight snapshot acceptance rows and distinct Local
control/authenticity proof. Original REQ08 partial preparation remains historical.
The six helper paths plus new return/proof are the eight expected worker outputs;
the two entrypoint inputs are not invented changed deliverables.

## Evidence / Verification

Current results are bound in the Local evidence JSON named above. The actual
production CLI evaluates one copied prospective work order using its explicit
isolated repository root and exact snapshot bytes. Copies of its real named
predecessor/evidence remain hash checked. It is a declared-state snapshot check,
not a production dispatch, a full bundle PASS or host feasibility proof.
The temporary ACTIVE projection is used only to inspect the prospective role
graph; the candidate itself stays HOLD. Both outcomes and scope are disclosed.
